title: Orquest job-first occupation reference catalog
provenance: Converted from teammate-provided Markdown; individual rows not independently checked
usage_notes: Keep existing Orquest career IDs and data unchanged; map SOC-based reference IDs to existing careers explicitly.
Job-family grouping is for exploration only. Use a specific occupation ID for job-first roadmaps.
National May 2025 wages, not Florida/Miami salaries.
Typical entry-level education is descriptive, not a strict universal licensing requirement.
MDC programs, learning resources, and job vacancies are not included; only add verified sources separately.
